messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal has taken over the catalog service from Team Dune. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the catalog service as of the 2025-03-20 ownership transfer. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-06-16; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-catalog]
    earlier: Team Cinder owns the catalog service. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- On 2025-04-18, Team Atlas reported that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18-2]
- On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-04]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler went to Team Atlas, not Team Cinder; Team Cinder never owned it, and the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder; the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-08-29 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-29]
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-03-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-catalog]
- Dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed as of 2025-06-16. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
- On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the catalog service is not Team Boreal's service. [valid 2025-05-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-08]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service sits with Team Dune; Team Boreal no longer owns it. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-04]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- The catalog service depends on the resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]

Question: Who owns the catalog today?

message.reasoning: The memory says as of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service, valid to now. Today is 2026-06-30. So answer: Team Boreal.
